items.title: EXT-005/SD-031 out-of-distribution attribution robustness under causal-structure shift
items.note: GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): reanalysis_query.py query --readout auroc_move_ok --claim EXT-005 -> exactly one manifest carries this readout (V3-EXQ-995, substrate_hash 4a1f8a270610f897...), IN-DISTRIBUTION ONLY, no causal-structure shift applied -> decisive OOD readout NOT RECOVERABLE from any existing manifest -> run. Substrate readiness (Step 2.5/2.5a): SD-031's E2WorldForward comparator CONFIRMED implemented and live (V3-EXQ-995 PASSED 2026-09-03T19:44:56Z on the identical construction this driver reuses; e2world_action_pathway_live measured 0.283 at init). The one new substrate dependency (CausalGridWorld._action_map as an instance-level override point, causal_grid_world.py:789-792/2287-2299) was read from source AND empirically probed at authoring time (Step 2.5a): overwriting env._action_map after construction with world_rule_shift_enabled left at its default False (so the periodic SD-MEL-PRODUCER schedule never fires) correctly rewires realised displacement -- action 0 pre-shift (-1,0) produced (1,0) post-shift exactly as specified, confirmed by a live one-tick probe, not by reading the docstring alone. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): only one autopsy names EXT-005/SD-031 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-783_2026-07-18, already REFUTED by its own prescribed retest per V3-EXQ-995's own docstring) -- count 1 < threshold 2, brake does not fire; this experiment is in any case a NEW manipulation (causal-structure shift) on a different design axis from V3-EXQ-995, not a re-derive of its design. Substrate-path overlap (Step 2.5c): driver footprint identical to V3-EXQ-995's plus the _action_map override (already inside causal_grid_world.py, V3-EXQ-995's own footprint). Two open CORRUPTING substrate_queue entries overlap this footprint (mode-governance-engagement: agent.py/utils/config.py; SD-082: agent.py) -- both gated off, VERIFIED LIVE on this driver's own REEConfig.from_dims(...) construction (not merely assumed from V3-EXQ-995's check): salience_affinity_input_cap=None, use_lateral_pfc_analog=False. Open DEGRADING entries recorded, identical to V3-EXQ-995's own known_substrate_limitations list (SD-018, mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism, SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING). Default-off flag audit: ENV_KWARGS identical to V3-EXQ-995 (contamination_spread=0.0 per the V3-EXQ-513 precedent; reef_enabled/hazard_agent_pursuit/hazard_food_attraction all off/0.0 by construction). red-team (Step 4.5, DIFFERENT model, model=fable, TWO independent passes, 2026-09-04): PASS 1 verdict BLOCKING on the pre-fix design -- the original D1/D2 (gap-vs-bare only) criterion was satisfiable by a chance-level comparator (995's own bare MOVE_OK AUROC sits below chance, 0.42-0.45) and separately by a comparator that had lost its action-conditioning entirely (995's own action-shuffled control already beats bare by 0.08-0.10, above the old 0.05 floor), plus no readiness gate on PRE_BASE's own in-distribution signature and no non-vacuity check on the readapt budget. Fixed: D1/D2 are now TRIPLE-gated (gap-vs-bare AND gap-vs-chance AND gap-vs-shuffled-action, each noise-aware), plus three new readiness preconditions (pre_base_in_distribution_signature, shift_degrades_frozen_forward_fit, readapt_does_not_regress_frozen_fit) and a per-claim evidence_direction fix (only SD-031 is actually exercised; ARC-037/MECH-095/EXT-005 now unconditionally non_contributory, matching the run's own attribution_caveat). PASS 2 (same model, fresh session, fix-verification only) verdict CONTESTED: all 8 findings' fixes verified correctly wired to the right arm/quantity and non-inverted; two non-fatal gaps (readapt non-vacuity gate admitted an exact-zero recovery; the narrowed causal-claim scope lived only in the docstring, not claim_scope) were both closed in a third, non-red-teamed follow-up pass. One documented, deliberately-NOT-fixed residual limitation: no scratch-model / unshifted-env positive control establishes what MAGNITUDE of D2 recovery the readapt budget should achieve (only that it achieves SOME, degradation-scaled, recovery) -- recorded as an OPEN RESIDUAL LIMITATION in the module docstring and the session report, out of scope for this pass (roughly doubles post-shift compute/arm-count). validate_experiments.py --strict passes clean (0 warnings, ~30 categories) and the --dry-run smoke test runs end-to-end with the new preconditions computing correctly (pre_base_in_distribution_signature and causal_class_events_sufficient both correctly self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue at toy dry-run scale, as expected; the other 9 preconditions pass). Full reasoning trace in the session report. Cross-machine-class safe: rank-statistic AUROC readouts over deterministic forward passes, no torch.multinomial-dependent assertions.

items.title: GAP-14 successor: LIVE phase-gate validation via env_kwargs() (crossing-count vs legacy spike), with a raw-trajectory-divergence precondition -- 591h vacuity fix
items.note:
REDESIGN of V3-EXQ-591h (NEW EXQ number, not a 591 letter, per infant_gap14_redesign_staged_20260827.md and the autopsy's own instruction (c)). Routed by the user-adjudicated failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-591h_2026-09-03 (ratified REE_assembly d51fc6aaa5, recorded on infant_substrate:GAP-14 governance_2026_09_03): 591h PASSED 5/5 seeds but was VACUOUS -- per_episode_h_pos was BIT-IDENTICAL between ARM_SPIKE and ARM_CROSSING on 5/5 seeds because the only phase->agent channel the 591b-591h lineage wired was config.e3.novelty_bonus_weight, whose consuming branch was DELETED 2026-05-25 (dead-by-construction).

ORIGINAL GOVERNANCE INSTRUCTION named TWO required live channels: env_kwargs() and config_overrides()['offline_integration_frequency']. THIS DESIGN SHIPS ONLY ONE (env_kwargs()) -- the second was investigated, wired in a first draft, then DROPPED after the mandatory Step 4.5 adversarial red-team (run on a different model, fable) found the workaround for it was itself a dead channel. Full disposition below.

(a) env_kwargs() -- LIVE, SHIPPED. InfantCurriculumScheduler.env_kwargs() is spread in full into the CausalGridWorldV2 constructor every episode (harm_gradient_enabled -> causal_grid_world.py:2617 harm-gradient reward term consumed by update_residue() -> ResidueField.accumulate() -> ARC-046 hazard-avoidance term in E3 trajectory scoring; transient_benefit_enabled -> :3077 stochastic benefit-patch spawn). Genuine closed loop, verified reachable by direct construction probe (Step 2.5a) before any script code was written, AND verified firing live in the final script via a diagnostic tick counter (info['transition_type']=='harm_gradient'; see n_harm_gradient_ticks / n_harm_gradient_ticks_by_cell in the manifest) -- added specifically per red-team finding F3 to directly confirm the channel engages, not merely that it is wired.

(b) offline_integration_frequency -- INVESTIGATED, NOT SHIPPED (RED-TEAM F1). config_overrides()['offline_integration_frequency'] (10->20 on Phase0->1) matches agent.py:12070's should_integrate() cadence field, but REEAgent.offline_integration() itself is confirmed-broken (a bare torch.cat([s,w]) at default dim=0 instead of dim=-1, agent.py ~12053-12058, crashing once the E1 experience buffer exceeds 10 entries -- confirmed via a direct 15-step probe and by comparison to the correct sibling usage at agent.py:5775-5777; this is why grep confirms zero scripts in the whole ree-v3/experiments/ corpus have ever called agent.offline_integration() or agent.should_integrate()). A FIRST DRAFT worked around this by calling should_integrate() at the correct cadence and, on a True tick, invoking only the confirmed-safe residue-only half, agent.residue_field.integrate(). Step 4.5 red-team (fable) found THIS HALF IS ITSELF DEAD: ResidueField.integrate() (ree_core/residue/field.py:1120-1141) computes F.mse_loss(neural_field(...), rbf_field(...)).item() with NO .backward(), NO optimizer, NO .step(), and NO in-place write anywhere -- neural_field's parameters are referenced nowhere else in the whole ree_core/ tree, so nothing anywhere trains them. Its only real effect is that torch.randn_like(...) (10 draws/call) advances the GLOBAL torch RNG stream, which every downstream stochastic draw (CEM noise, E3 multinomial, replay) then consumes differently on a schedule correlated with curriculum phase -- a genuine but SPURIOUS source of per_episode_h_pos divergence between arms that the new P6 precondition (below) CANNOT distinguish from a real one. Wiring it as originally drafted would have manufactured a subtler repeat of the exact 591h vacuity failure rather than fixing it. DECISION: this channel is not wired at all in the shipped script; agent.config.offline_integration_frequency is never set; should_integrate()/residue_field.integrate() are never called. Recorded as TWO entries in the manifest's substrate_defect_found (one per confirmed-dead half) and folded into scope_limitation. config.e3.novelty_bonus_weight remains deliberately unwritten too (dead since 2026-05-25, per the original instruction).

NEW LOAD-BEARING PRECONDITION (governance requirement (b), independent of the channel-count question above): raw_trajectory_divergence_present, evaluated FIRST (before gate_green/dropout_bypassed/c_discriminates) -- counts episodes across ALL seeds where ARM_SPIKE and ARM_CROSSING's RAW per_episode_h_pos sequences differ by more than float noise (|diff|>1e-9). This is the exact guard 591h lacked: its own C_arms_differ compared the gate's DECISION output (reached_phase1, phase_01_at), which can (and did) report True even while behaviour was bit-identical, because a different threshold applied to an IDENTICAL underlying signal still fires at a different episode. Below floor -> label=substrate_not_ready_requeue / vacuous, never a substrate-verdict label. C_arms_differ_decision_level is retained as a diagnostic-only (non-load-bearing) criterion, explicitly named in the script docstring as 'the 591h-insufficient statistic'. New EXQ number, claim-free (CLAIM_IDS=[]; 591h's ARC-019 tag is not carried forward, per the autopsy's tag-removal instruction).

RED-TEAM (Step 4.5, fable, independent model from the author) -- SECOND FINDING (F2), ALSO FIXED: once env_kwargs() is genuinely live, ARM_SPIKE's own post-advance episodes run under different (Phase-1) dynamics that depend on ARM_SPIKE's own gate decision -- so the ORACLE (h_pos_mean_full_run on ARM_SPIKE, used as ground truth for 'is this seed a genuine explorer') and P2 (a post-hoc recount of ARM_SPIKE's post-advance h_pos values against the spike threshold) both became contaminated by the manipulation under test, unlike in 591h where env_kwargs was informational-only. FIXED: (i) oracle switched to h_pos_mean_pre_ep_min -- the mean over episodes [0, PHASE_EP_MIN[1]=100), provably Phase-0-only and bit-identical-in-composition across arms since InfantCurriculumScheduler._try_phase_0_to_1 refuses to advance before episode 100 under either gate rule; the ORACLE_H_POS_MEAN_FLOOR=0.20 numeral was originally calibrated against 591d/591f's full-run means, so applying it to the pre-ep_min statistic is an approximation -- readiness preconditions P3/P4 self-route to substrate_not_ready_requeue rather than silently passing through a poorly-calibrated floor. (ii) P2 (crossing_counts_reach_gate_minimum) switched to read ARM_CROSSING's own live scheduler_crossing_count directly (the exact statistic the gate itself computes and routes on) instead of a post-hoc recount off a different arm's trajectory.

RED-TEAM MINOR/NOTE FINDINGS (no further script change beyond F3's cheap sharpening, described under channel (a) above): F4 confirmed the torch.cat bug claim is real (independently traced); F5 verified no other vacuity risk (arm_cell resets all RNG per seed so Phase-0 trajectories are cross-arm bit-identical by construction; replay_diversity_enabled defaults False so hippocampal stdlib-random sites are unreachable; residue_scale_factor scope note accurate; env-kwarg spread, should_integrate() arithmetic, scheduler wiring, and phase-timing bounds all check out); F6 (cosmetic) corrected a pre-filled 'red-team: CLEAR' docstring line that predated the actual review.

SCOPE LIMITATIONS (deliberate, documented in the script docstring and manifest): config.e3.novelty_bonus_weight NOT written (dead channel). residue_scale_factor NOT applied (governance named only env_kwargs()+offline_integration_frequency as required channels; out of scope to add a third). offline_integration_frequency NOT applied at all (see RED-TEAM F1 above -- both its E1-replay half and its residue-only half are confirmed dead). No torch.multinomial-dependent assertions on committed/sampled actions -- all thresholds are on upstream continuous quantities (h_pos, crossing counts), for cross-machine-class safety.

GOV-REUSE-1 (2.4): decisive readout n_diverging_episodes_total / C_live_gate_discriminates. Checked evidence/experiments/ and the queue/experiments tree for any existing run wiring env_kwargs() live on this curriculum -- none found (only the 591 lineage exists, all confirmed wiring only novelty_bonus_weight). Not recoverable from existing data -> run.

STEP 2.5c (substrate-path overlap gate): queried evidence/planning/substrate_queue.json for open 'corrupting' entries touching causal_grid_world.py/agent.py/infant_curriculum.py. Two found (mode-governance-engagement, SD-082) -- both gated behind flags (use_salience_coordinator/use_external_task_drive, use_lateral_pfc_analog) this script's diversity-armed build does not enable (verified against _agent_config_kwargs()). Ruled non-blocking.

COUPLED CONTRACT PIN CHECKED (ree-v3/tests/contracts/test_infant_curriculum_gap9.py:262-264, test_c7_config_overrides): read in full -- it asserts only properties of InfantCurriculumScheduler.config_overrides()'s own return value (residue_scale_factor increasing, offline_integration_frequency increasing 10->20, novelty_bonus_weight>0 in every phase), never references any 591-family driver. This script does not modify config_overrides()'s shape, only which fields (if any) the driver consumes. NO CHANGE NEEDED; no working-tree changes were made to this file or any other tracked file (the new driver script is the only untracked addition).

DESIGN (unchanged from 591f/591h): discriminative pair, ARM_SPIKE (legacy single-episode spike gate) vs ARM_CROSSING (phase_0to1_use_crossing_count=True, min 3 crossings per 591f). Seeds 42-46, 160 episodes, 200 steps/episode, diversity-armed agent (MECH-313 noise floor + MECH-314 structured curiosity, SP-CEM main-path default). REFERENCE_591F frozen positive-control cells (verified byte-identical to 591h's own values) used via assert_anchor_reachable at setup to structurally prove every readiness predicate can clear its own gate -- unaffected by the pre-ep_min oracle switch since it is a structural check on the predicate machinery only, not a live-run comparison. Readiness preconditions P1/P3/P4/P5 carried over unchanged (spike-arm-reproduces-advance>=2, oracle-genuine-explorers-present>=1, oracle-non-explorers-present>=1, live-false-advancer-present>=1); P2 redefined per red-team F2 above. LOAD-BEARING C_live_gate_discriminates: in ARM_CROSSING, for every seed, the live phase-advance decision agrees with the ORACLE label -- gated behind the new P6 divergence precondition.

validate_experiments.py --strict: clean pass, 0 warnings across all 30 checks, no exemptions (re-verified after the F1/F2 fixes). --dry-run smoke (2 seeds x 2 arms, 3 episodes x 25 steps): exit 0 both before and after the F1/F2 fixes, all 4 cells ran to completion with real env_kwargs applied per phase (confirmed via [train] log lines printing the live env_kwargs dict each episode), z_goal_stream smoke 'no writer defect', correctly self-routed label=substrate_not_ready_requeue (expected at toy scale -- no seed reaches the spike gate in 3 episodes, so precondition P1 correctly fails closed rather than asserting a false substrate verdict).

COST: estimated_minutes set to 360, matching 591h's OWN measured wall-clock (5h46m for the same 2-arm x 5-seed x 160-episode x 200-step design on ree-cloud-2, per that queue entry's own COST note) -- this script's overhead beyond 591h's (env_kwargs() spread, one diagnostic tick counter) is negligible relative to per-step CEM planning cost, and it does LESS work than a first-draft two-channel version would have (no should_integrate()/residue_field.integrate() calls at all), so the per-step cost profile is at or below 591h's.
